Beginner
5C  Pronunciation
Description
Students review common regular verbs and practise the pronunciation of -ed endings
Lesson link
Use this activity after exercise 5e, page 49
Time
10 minutes
Extra material Print out, photocopy and cut the How do you pronounce…? worksheet – one half for each student
Instructions
a Draw SS’ attention to the verb stay in exercise 5d.
Ask SS which pronunciation is used for the -ed
ending. Elicit /d/.
b Divide SS into pairs, preferably sitting opposite
each other, and give each pair a copy of the
worksheet. Tell SS not to look at each other’s
worksheets.
c SS have to say their verbs aloud in the past and
decide which pronunciation is correct (/d/, /t/, or /
Id/) ending. The other student can then say ‘yes’
or ‘no’ to guide their partner. Competitive SS can
keep score if they want.
d When SS have finished, go over any
pronunciations that SS found difficult. You could
also ask SS to spell any verbs where the spelling
changes in the past.
activities: Ask SS which pronunciation is used for the -ed
